releaseNotes: Safe Disconnect presentation now keeps the last live dashboard snapshot visually frozen while the existing protected disconnect lifecycle runs, then confirms transport release before fading into the offline state.

The disconnect overlay now presents three operator-facing stages—live presentation freeze, protected teardown in progress, and transport-release confirmation—followed by a short 'Disconnected safely' confirmation instead of disappearing at the same instant the cards switch offline.

All new timing is presentation-only and runs beside/after the existing RuntimeStopGuard lifecycle. No delay was added before Disconnect, and Safe Disconnect, RuntimeStopGuard, socket/queue teardown, PDO/ISDU, polling/MAX, network recovery, and disconnect feedback contracts are unchanged.

V969 GitHub Contents API primary update-manifest authority, V968 Signal splash, FIX27 AI evidence scope, FIX26 HMI/9-segment visualization, and all existing communication/runtime protection remain preserved.

en: Safe Disconnect now freezes the last live dashboard presentation, shows protected teardown progress, confirms transport release, briefly reports 'Disconnected safely', and then fades into the offline dashboard.
The UI transition is presentation-only and never delays or replaces the existing protected Disconnect/RuntimeStopGuard lifecycle.
No socket, SerialCommandQueue, polling/MAX, PDO/ISDU, recovery, Runtime, Signal Tower control, HMI, or AI behavior was changed.
The V969 update-manifest authority fix and V968 Signal splash remain intact.
ko: Safe Disconnect 시 마지막 라이브 Dashboard 화면을 고정한 상태로 보호 해제 진행 상황을 표시하고, 통신 해제를 확인한 뒤 '안전하게 연결 해제되었습니다'를 잠시 보여준 후 Offline 화면으로 자연스럽게 전환합니다.
이번 변경은 UI Presentation 전용이며 기존 Disconnect/RuntimeStopGuard 보호 절차를 지연하거나 대체하지 않습니다.
Socket, SerialCommandQueue, Polling/MAX, PDO/ISDU, Recovery, Runtime, Signal Tower 실제 제어, HMI, AI 동작은 변경하지 않았습니다.
V969 자동 업데이트 Manifest Authority 패치와 V968 Signal Splash도 그대로 유지됩니다.
ja: Safe Disconnect では最後のライブ Dashboard 表示を固定し、保護された切断処理、通信解放確認、『安全に切断されました』の短い確認表示を経て Offline 画面へ滑らかに移行します。
この変更は UI Presentation 専用で、既存の Disconnect/RuntimeStopGuard 保護ライフサイクルを遅延・置換しません。
Socket、SerialCommandQueue、Polling/MAX、PDO/ISDU、Recovery、Runtime、Signal Tower 実制御、HMI、AI の動作は変更していません。
V969 の Update Manifest Authority 修正と V968 Signal Splash も維持されます。
zh-CN: Safe Disconnect 现在会冻结最后一帧实时 Dashboard，显示受保护的断开进度，确认通信释放，短暂显示“已安全断开连接”，然后平滑过渡到 Offline 画面。
本次修改仅属于 UI Presentation，不会延迟或替换现有 Disconnect/RuntimeStopGuard 保护流程。
Socket、SerialCommandQueue、Polling/MAX、PDO/ISDU、Recovery、Runtime、Signal Tower 实际控制、HMI 与 AI 行为均未修改。
V969 更新 Manifest Authority 修复与 V968 Signal Splash 均保持不变。
de: Safe Disconnect friert nun die letzte Live-Dashboard-Darstellung ein, zeigt den geschützten Trennfortschritt, bestätigt die Kommunikationsfreigabe, zeigt kurz 'Sicher getrennt' und blendet anschließend weich in den Offline-Zustand über.
Die Änderung betrifft ausschließlich die UI-Darstellung und verzögert oder ersetzt den bestehenden geschützten Disconnect/RuntimeStopGuard-Ablauf nicht.
Socket, SerialCommandQueue, Polling/MAX, PDO/ISDU, Recovery, Runtime, reale Signal-Tower-Steuerung, HMI und AI bleiben unverändert.
Der V969 Update-Manifest-Authority-Fix und der V968 Signal Splash bleiben erhalten.
es: Safe Disconnect ahora congela la última vista Live del Dashboard, muestra el progreso de desconexión protegida, confirma la liberación de la comunicación, muestra brevemente 'Desconectado de forma segura' y después hace una transición suave al estado Offline.
El cambio es exclusivamente de presentación UI y no retrasa ni sustituye el ciclo protegido Disconnect/RuntimeStopGuard existente.
Socket, SerialCommandQueue, Polling/MAX, PDO/ISDU, Recovery, Runtime, control real de Signal Tower, HMI y AI no cambian.
Se conservan la corrección V969 de Update Manifest Authority y el Signal Splash de V968.
